description: This source file defines the ShopOrder class, which models an order in an e-commerce web application. It extends PersistableOrder and includes fields for shopping cart items, order total summary, shipping details, payment information, and error handling.

classes.name: ShopOrder
classes.description: Represents a customer's order with associated cart items, shipping, payment, and summary details.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items for the order.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items associated with the order.

methods.name: setOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Sets the total summary details of the order.

methods.name: getOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the total summary details of the order.

methods.name: setSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Sets the shipping option selected by the user.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves any error message associated with the order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message for the order.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Retrieves payment information as key-value pairs.
